inference: Exploratory OFAT screen: three paired seeds on one preselected tail case per size. Configurations share a frozen numerical base. No significance, benchmark-wide superiority, or holdout claim follows from this panel.
timing_scope: Full per-cell search wall budget. Nominal observations exclude overshoot. Misses are censored at their own horizon. No pooled mixed-budget time.
